reviews.title: Best nap and focus app

reviews.title: Obvious Jewel
reviews.text:
I purchased this app years ago and used to a bit, but I didn’t have the technology at the time to really make it work. Now I have headphones that don’t interrupt my sleeping. this has enabled me to get tons out of the app.

As I said, I purchased this app years ago long before it expanded into what it is today. My only wishes that I could turn off all of the other things, and just use the classic product which I purchased. Well it is possible to do that, what I’m asking for is the ability to turn off all the reminders and screens that I have to remember to click through so that I can just use the sleep and Knapp classic products which I purchased so long ago. 

I don’t like subscriptions. The other option is offer another lifetime.

reviews.title: Crashes on iOS 26
reviews.text:
UPDATE: This was fixed within the first week of iOS 26 release. I got a response from the developer that they’re committed to updating the app. So happy to be able to update my review and give them the 5 stars they deserve. This is a must-have app for power napping. Hoping in the future they’ll watch for instability during the public beta period. 

ORIGINAL REVIEW: I love this app and have used it for power naps for years. I hope they’re still supporting it because it’s currently unusable and immediately crashes upon opening.

reviews.title: Used to be great. Not anymore
reviews.text:
(TLDR; charges you without providing anything. Sad because it used to be good.)

First used this years ago. It was really helpful, but eventually I didn't need it anymore. Got out of the habit of using. Recent events and illness have impacted my sleep, so I thought this would be a pleasant and nostalgic return to something that helped in the past.

Nope. The app begs for money now. Thought "sure, why not, I'll buy a year. It's a good app." Nope. Took my money without giving me any access to any of the paid features.

The begging for subscription looks pretty... that was important to someone in development. Too bad the actual delivery of content to paying users wasn't of similar priority.

reviews.title: Phenomenal App
reviews.text:
I use it almost every day at work to keep me focused.  I don’t sleep a lot (pain issues) and the “Focus” movement music keeps me on task vs. putting me to sleep. 

I’ve no idea how one writes purpose-driven music, especially the Focus aspect without either making it obnoxious or inadvertently putting me to sleep, but they pulled it off in spades.

reviews.title: I LOVE THIS APP
reviews.text: I’ve actually used this app for over 10 years? I want to say? I don’t know but it’s been a looong time. I LOVE Abbe’s voice, and Anna’s hypnosis; The journeys and the myths. One of my favorites is “the wardrobe of your feelings” where I pick out clothes (in my mind) that will make me feel my most confident 💁🏽‍♀️ I fall asleep thinking about the best version of myself and after all these years I’m actually turning into that person day by day and I credit Pzizz with a lot of that (not to be dramatic). Other favs include An Inca Journey With an Alpaca, and The Rockabye Railway. Who doesn’t want to fall asleep on a soothing train ride? By the time Abbe gets to the part about hot cocoa I’m usually out lol. I use it for sleep at night, meditations during the day and when I started I didn’t have kids but now I have two daughters and they also know when it’s a Pzizz kind of night. It’s not a punishment of any kind! It’s a treat! They’re only 5 & 6 but they know it works. They love Daughters of The Air, Alice Underground, Petite Snow White and many others. My fav soundscape is still Classic Pzizz Sleep - the binaural beats are top notch. Thank you Pzizz for an app that is stress free to use (this part is so important - can’t stress this enough), the wonderful stories, and the voices that I’ve come to associate with coziness and calm. It’s perfection or I wouldn’t still be here 10+ years later. I check the “new” list all the time and I’m delighted anytime there’s anything new because I know it’s going to be awesome.

reviews.title: Great app that keeps getting better.
reviews.text: What is one good night of sleep worth to you? I wish everything I like was free or really cheap. Unfortunately, none of it is... This app is great for helping me with sleep. The developer is constantly making it better. That is important for me as require it to be different at times. I love how this app keeps going for as long as I want. Many competing products last a few minutes... useless. It is wonderful we have options. I hope everyone finds a sleep app that works for them. I find this app to be a very reasonable price for what I receive. Keep up the great work guys. This newest update is amazing!

reviews.title: It’s ok, but…
reviews.text:
I downloaded this app so I could sleep better. After a few days I got a pop-up saying I had to purchase the subscription to change anything. Why is changing your settings for the sounds locked behind a paywall? I mean, I know you have to make money somehow but locking any customization is a bit far in my opinion. Now I’m not able to sleep well with it because I can’t customize any of my sounds. It’s truly annoying.

If you will even take my review into consideration, I have an idea. Let people customize their sounds but make it slightly gated. What I mean by this is let people choose the categories they want a random sound from and if they want to choose a specific sound, that can be gated. It makes it so it’s not too much behind a paywall but enough that users are able to actually use the app well after their free trial ended.

If you take my idea into consideration, maybe I’ll consider re-downloading the app.

reviews.title: Excellent program overall
reviews.text:
Whether it is sleep, nap or helping to focus during my work, Pzizz is excellent. I really like the sleepy history series as well as the mindfulness and meditation tracks but appreciate the variety of types of sleep tracks offered and ability to adjust voice and music/background volumes separately. I do see some areas where improvements could help, though. 

1) I would appreciate other options for ways to pay than yearly subscriptions. This is an app I would like to use for years, so being able to flat out purchase it, with the option of purchasing additional track bundles rather than only the subscription options would be appreciated. The developer response did not address this. 
2. I also wish there were more variety in speakers available for nap tracks: most options only have a single female voice available. Having more options for male voices voices would be appreciated.  The developers state they are working on this. 
3. I would really appreciate the ability to mark the few backgrounds or vocals that I dislike. There aren’t many, but it would be nice to use the randomization feature without it picking a few of the tracks that don’t well for me. There’s one main one I can think of where the sound comes on intermittently enough that it tends to disrupt my sleep every time the sound kicks in unless i specifically choose what soundscape to play. The developer response stated there is a dislike option but maybe that is android phone only as I have the latest iPhone version and my only options are to delete it or mark it as a favorite.  

One thing I have enjoyed over subscribing the last year is how much the program has expanded the different narratives available.

I deleted and downloaded the app. Of course now it asked for sign-in and subscription. I skipped all of that. I get to the SLEEP, NAP, FOCUS screen. I selected nap and the desired length of time. I clicked the check mark and NO AUDIO. I can see something running because I see bar graph moving (raising/lowering). Similar thing is happening on my other apple product. As per Apple requirement, developer’s can eventually upgrade to subscription but the for the ORIGINAL purchasers get grandfathered in providing only all the features as the original. One thing still working, the ALARM. It sounds off when the selected time lapsed. So please fix it!!!
